## 3-Layer Expertise Graph

### Layer 1: Core Foundation (AI-Powered Full-Stack Engineering)
- **Frontend**: React.js, Next.js (App Router, Server Components), HTML5, CSS3/Sass, Responsive UI Architecture, GSAP Animation.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, RESTful API Design, JWT Authentication, Middleware, Server Architecture.
- **Database & Data Modeling**: MongoDB, Mongoose, schema design, indexing, CRUD operations.
- **Tooling**: Git, GitHub, npm, Vercel, Netlify, VS Code.

### Layer 2: Differentiation (Real-Time + AI Web Applications)
- **Real-Time Protocols**: Socket.io, WebSockets, WebRTC (peer-to-peer audio/video streaming, data channels).
- **Interactive Collaboration**: Real-time multi-user chat, presence detection, live updates, low-latency state synchronization.
- **Streaming AI**: Real-time token streaming UX, prompt pipeline design, resilient API error fallbacks.
- **Architecture**: Modular component systems, predictable state flow, 60fps micro-animations.

### Layer 3: Emerging Specialization (Generative AI Application Development)
- **Model APIs**: Google Gemini API, OpenAI API integrations.
- **LLM Engineering**: Prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, system instructions, context window optimization.
- **Multimodal AI**: Image analysis, vision-to-text generation, contextual dialogue chaining.
- **AI UX**: Intelligent auto-replies, conversational user interfaces, generative captioning pipelines.

## Flagship Projects

### 1. ConnectX — Real-Time Communication Platform
- **Description**: Real-time communication platform enabling chat, voice, and video calling with adaptive video quality and AI-powered smart reply suggestions.
- **Architecture**: Peer-to-peer WebRTC connections with Socket.io signaling, Express backend, Redux Toolkit state management, and integrated generative AI reply suggestions.
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, Express.js, Socket.io, WebRTC, Redux Toolkit, React, Generative AI.
- **Live Demo**: https://connectx-chat-with.netlify.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/sudhanshu9199/chat-APP-Like

### 2. AURA — AI Conversational Assistant
- **Description**: Intelligent AI chat application powered by Gemini API, designed for natural, context-aware dialogues retaining historical thread memory.
- **Architecture**: React frontend with streaming response rendering, serverless Gemini API integration, and adaptive theme controls.
- **Tech Stack**: React, JavaScript, Gemini API, AI Integration.
- **Live Demo**: https://first-chatbot-ai.netlify.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/sudhanshu9199/AI-ChatBot

### 3. Caption Generator AI — Multimodal Social Media Tool
- **Description**: Multimodal AI application analyzing uploaded images and automatically generating engaging, contextual captions for social media publishing.
- **Architecture**: Vision model pipeline, JWT user authentication, MongoDB storage for saved generations, and React/Vite client interface.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Vite, MongoDB, JWT, Multimodal AI APIs, Prompt Engineering.
- **Live Demo**: https://caption-generator-ai.netlify.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/sudhanshu9199/caption-generator-AI
